pages.text: $(bold)Village Recruits$() (the base mod) hires soldiers; its $(bold)Village Expansion$() addon gives towns names, factions, politics and growth. $(bold)Guard Villagers$() man the walls. $(bold)Villager Workers$() are hired labour. $(bold)Villager Comfort$(), $(bold)Villager Names$() and sleeping to restock make villagers people.

$(bold)Bountiful$() posts jobs. $(bold)Doggy Talents$() makes dogs. $(bold)More Mob Variants$() breeds the farm animals; $(bold)Naturalist$() makes the wild ones; $(bold)Aquaculture$() (+Delight) fish; $(bold)Farmer's Delight$() the kitchen.
